items.title: Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley are dominating the AI stock boom. Here's their edge
items.summary: Fueled by the global boom in artificial intelligence stocks, relaxed capital rules and greater lending to hedge funds, big Wall Street banks have already had a banner year for equities trading — even with one quarter left to go.

items.title: Jobless claims near the lowest since the 1960s as low-fire trend continues
items.summary: Employers continue to hold onto workers even as hiring remains weak, sending weekly jobless claims to around their lowest levels in records that stretch back nearly six decades.

items.title: Trump's approval rating on economy hits all-time low as midterm looms: CNBC survey
items.summary: With less than two weeks to go before the congressional elections, Americans are nearly as gloomy about the economy as they were when the nation was emerging from the pandemic, and President Donald Trump 's economic approval rating is hitting an all-time low, according to the latest CNBC All-America Economic Survey .
